replay.note: the advocates' outputs were replayed from an earlier run and not regenerated by this one: only the judge was called, so the figures here measure the judge's behaviour on fixed inputs and not the whole pipeline

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and to the driver: this ruling decides the $8.00 cancellation fee and the driver's compensation on the record for trip TRP-00208.

THE FEE STANDS (rider's claim rejected). Your account, ma'am, is that the driver never came and that you waited about 15 minutes at the condo guardhouse and could not reach him. The evidence does not support that, and your own advocate correctly declined to press it. The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 16:02:25 and the GPS trace places the driver inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE pickup radius from 16:02:10 — at or before that event — with 60 qualifying in-radius fixes, so arrival under POL-NS-02 is established well beyond the three consecutive fixes the clause requires. The driver then held position continuously for 585 seconds (9 min 45 s) from that first qualifying fix, against the 300-second minimum for this zone class, so POL-NS-01 limb (c) holds; and the trip was terminated by the driver at 16:12:10 on reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the required dwell had elapsed, with no boarding event, so limb (d) holds. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 are satisfied. The fee of $8.00 is correctly chargeable.

WHY NO REFUND IS PAYABLE UNDER ANY RIDER-SIDE CLAUSE. POL-NS-06 (shortfall) does not apply: the dwell of 585 s exceeds the 300 s minimum by 285 s, and both sides in fact concede there is no shortfall. POL-NS-04 does not apply: the driver replied to your 'coming coming 2 min' message at 16:08:02 with 'ok no problem' at 16:08:20, eighteen seconds later and inside the 120-second window, and additionally placed an in-app voice call at 16:09:40 that was answered for 34 seconds, so limb (b) fails; and your own device track records zero qualifying fixes inside the 150 m rider-presence radius, sitting 634–646 m inside the estate throughout the waiting window, so limb (c) is affirmatively failed. POL-NS-03 (wrong-entrance) does not apply because the driver's qualifying fixes are inside the arrival radius, not outside it but within 400 m. POL-NS-05 (false arrival marker) does not apply: at the marked arrival time the driver's track shows 0.0 kph — stationary — and his closest approach to the pin was about 28.8 m, so neither the 300 m nor the 15 kph trigger is met and the waiting clock needs no recomputation.

DRIVER COMPENSATION. Because POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, POL-NS-07 entitles the driver to 80 percent of the $8.00 fee itemised in the fare breakdown, which is $6.40; the remaining 20 percent is retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not withhold it: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the threshold of 4, and 2 divided by 143 completed trips in 30 days is about 1.4 percent, far below the 8 percent rate test — both limbs must be met and neither is. Under POL-GEN-03 the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and amount_sgd carries the same $6.40 figure; this moves the driver's payment and does not refund you, ma'am, and your $8.00 charge stands.

AMOUNT AND INTEGRITY. The $8.00 reconciles with fee_schedule.resolution_rule, being the GREATER of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee ($4.00) and the RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee ($8.00); the vehicle tier produced the higher figure, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect. No POL-NS-08 impairment applies: arrival-to-fix offset is 15 s (well under 90 s), the trace has no gaps and 120 fixes, the chat log holds exactly the 6 messages the trip record records with no gap over 5 minutes, and the fee reconciles. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact is at weight 1.0, so the confidence cap is 1.0 and no limb of POL-NS-09 escalates: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, there is no direct artifact-against-artifact contradiction on arrival, dwell or rider presence, the counterparty-dispute counters are 0 and 0, and the rider's no_show_disputes_30d is 1.

PROFILE FIELDS. The rider's prior_no_show_flags, rating and lifetime counters are context only under POL-GEN-01 and are not the fields POL-NS-09(d) reads; no adverse finding has been built on them, and both advocates correctly confined themselves to the citable counters.

MISSING ADVISORY. EV-ADVIS-00208-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT). No limb relied on by either side reaches it — POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unavailable but unnecessary, since the dwell met the minimum on its own — so its absence changes nothing in this ruling. It is noted per POL-GEN-02(3).

YOUR REQUEST FOR A CALL, ma'am: that is a service request, not something a clause in this policy directs into the referral list, so it has not been recorded as a referral. It is noted here so the support team can follow up separately. This ruling is final on the fee and on the compensation.
